title: ophrys aranifera subsp. helenae
intro: Ophrys aranifera subsp. helenae, commonly known as the Spider Orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. The Spider Orchid has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, thus providing relief from conditions such as high blood pressure and atherosclerosis. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Ophrys aranifera subsp. helenae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
